notes.title: Do not be afraid of your opinion, leave comments!
notes.notes:
Each person is unique and every opinion is interesting. I will continue to work on the game based on the comments under it: add something, change something, delete something. Everyone's opinion is important, I will read each review and if there are questions I will answer.

P.S.

When the game hits 350 reviews, Steam unlocks collectible cards. I will order special backgrounds from the artist's hentai. + Badges will be made based on their desires of the players!
